semantic.justification: ZIP stream/commit binding reuses actual ZIP32 owners. Typed output delegates standard content types to package; per-stream RelId follows OWriteStream_Impl::GetNewRelId. Ports only the consumed XML/package contract; native UNO services, general storage hierarchy, encrypted/ZIP64 packages, XLSB RecordParser and complete application document filters are outside this prerequisite. Strings/byte arrays and Promises bind host XML/ZIP transport; whole-module parity remains unverified.
